{
  "name": "next-steps-autopilot",
  "version": "0.6.0",
  "description": "A What next? button above the prompt box asks for suggested next prompts only when pressed. Type /auto to have suggestion 1 sent after a countdown you set; off by default.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Varun Moka",
    "url": "https://github.com/varunmoka7"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/varunmoka7/next-steps-autopilot",
  "repository": "https://github.com/varunmoka7/next-steps-autopilot",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "claude-code-plugin",
    "function-hooks",
    "suggestions",
    "next-steps",
    "autopilot"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "minAnswerChars": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Shortest answer to offer What next? after",
      "description": "Skip the What next? button after answers shorter than this many characters.",
      "required": false,
      "default": 80
    },
    "suggestSkills": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Suggest skills and slash commands",
      "description": "Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.",
      "required": false,
      "default": true
    },
    "autoSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Auto mode countdown (seconds)",
      "description": "How long /auto waits before sending suggestion 1. 0 sends at once. /auto <seconds> changes it for one session.",
      "required": false,
      "default": 10
    }
  }
}
